statement: A WASI component Cell start is instantiate-and-ready only, under the existing fixed STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS liveness bound: the jco transpile of the component (measured 97% of start time, 3.4-3.6 s of 3.5-3.7 s for the 12.9 MB h1 Hono component on the 20-core controller, and the sole cause of the hosted and lab 'Component startup timed out' failures) is derived once per (component sha256, jco-transpile version, world, instantiation mode) by a single node-side, single-flight derivation owned by WasiComponentCellRuntime, triggered at WasmComponentDriver prepare and awaited by start, reused across starts, restarts and replicas, bounded by artifact size, one derivation lane per node, a byte-proportional CPU-time ceiling and owner cancellation, and refused with typed request_cell_component_derivation_failed / request_cell_component_derivation_exhausted. A start that exceeds the liveness bound terminates its worker and fails typed request_cell_start_failed {phase, budgetMs, elapsedMs}; no orphaned worker remains. The 0.5 service tests h1-h5 and q2-q5 pass unchanged on this machine and at jobs=4 pinned to two cores.

constraints.statement: LAGRANGE_TEST_MACHINE_FACTOR / scaleByMachineFactor is never read by src: the hardware-relative-convergence-budget doctrine scales work-bound test budgets only and leaves src timers untouched; a test-only route into production is forbidden.

STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS is not raised; after the repair it bounds only worker spawn, memory cap, glue import, core compile, instantiate and the ready handshake (measured 0.1 s alone, 1.9 s at 8-way contention on one core).
Transpiled glue JS runs beside the host imports, so it is produced only on the node by the pinned toolchain from admitted component bytes; a deployer-supplied precompiled artifact is never accepted.
One derivation implementation serves both triggers (driver prepare, runtime start); no fallback to in-worker transpile; derivation outcomes are named typed states (R07, R11).

Red first: the deterministic slow-startup witness (fixture worker via the existing workerPath option, in a child process that must exit by itself) and the single-flight derivation count are red on 6d58fdba1 before any src change; the two-core jobs=4 run of h1/h2/h3/q4 is red on 6d58fdba1 (3/4 STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS, reproduced 2026-11-02). Independent verification before landing with the concurrency-serialization, sweep-timer, owner-interaction and harness-fidelity templates.
